يكتسبان (form VIII)
# يَكْتَسِبَانِ (yaktasibāni) /jak.ta.si.baː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِكْتَسَبَ (iktasaba)
# يُكْتَسَبَانِ (yuktasabāni) /juk.ta.sa.baː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِكْتَسَبَ (iktasaba)
